notes.title: Patch 28 April 2023
notes.content: We've fixed the issue where the metallic cube wasn't destroying the cracked cube properly. Please update your game to enjoy a smoother experience. Thank you for playing!

notes.title: Linux Support, Localization, and Menu Changes
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Linux support now available.
You can download the game on Linux from Steam. The game has been tested and works well on Ubuntu 22.04.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41588733/3289ac4225e4dedc9231436a05b7240961471468.png[/img]

[*] New localizations added: Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, and Japanese.
The new localizations can be found under Settings > Language.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41588733/2f4ae33a5b4aa84b0990d1a7a0ee4b2a93cdd40d.jpg[/img]

[*] Updated player stats menu.
We've rearranged some elements and added some details to the player stats menu.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41588733/41895d33555d3d66bdf4f99d39bb7e0071e6cf25.jpg[/img]

[*] Updated game tips window and text.
We've changed the game tips window from a slide-in/slide-out panel to a pop-up window. Most of the game tips text has been updated to provide better descriptions, and the game tips menu in the game menu has also been changed to a list view.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41588733/a4903f242221bbd85fc1d9394b54477be889d20f.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41588733/45a2a5aed4faf4a4ecaba1de78df39048e467a9d.jpg[/img]

[*] Added reset progress option.
You can reset your progress by going to Main Menu > Settings > Reset Progress. Please note: this action is not reversible.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41588733/e38d14c880d4e232bdd594a9cfa64dea2011c99f.jpg[/img]

[*] Some minor bug fixes. 
[/list]

notes.title: Patch 1.0.7
notes.content: Patch 1.0.7 fix bug level might not loaded properly or stuck in the loading screen.

notes.title: Patch 1.0.6
notes.content:
Patch 1.0.6 fixes:
- Fix heavy object pop-in when enter the game.
- Fix game tips of rotating platform not working properly.
- Excessively object loaded.
- Level might not loaded properly.

notes.title: World of Cube out now
notes.content:
World of cube is available on Steam with 20% off for launch week.

We also send patch to fix many bugs and improving the user experience . Thank you for your feedbacks during the development.

Hopefully you will enjoy the game.

notes.title: Release Date Announcement
notes.content:
Previously, we have announced the release date on our Facebook page. We apologize for the late announcement on Steam. World of Cube will be released on August 10, 2022.
Thanks for your support and feedbacks during the development.

notes.title: Update 0.6.0
notes.content:
Changes included in this update:
- Increase the movement.
The maximum movement speed is increased. However, the movement speed is reduced when the player is received movement penalty.
- Added Game Tips.
Game tips will be shown when a new object or mechanic is introduced. Player could re-read the game tips in the game menu.
